title: Freedi Pamular
subtitle: Independent
description: As one of two of the Pamular Brothers, Freedi spent his time working with Dewi, chopping fish pulled from the waters of Narkina. As a bulky fellow, Freedi seemed like he'd be a natural fighter, but the blades attached to his limbs aren't really used for that purpose, just for the fish. When Cassian Andor and Meishi arrived looking for a way off Narkina, the brothers were happy to oblige.
